budget_thresholds.escalation_rule: Use fast mode unless the task crosses an actual-agent, authority, guard, or failed-drift trigger; reserve heavy mode for cases where correctness depends on real multi-agent interpretation.

heavy_mode_minimum_budget.basis: Observed actual multi-agent Scenario 1 total external-agent time.

heavy_mode_recommended_budget.basis: 135.02 observed seconds plus buffer for quota retry, CLI variance, and post-merge rereading.

fast_mode_triggers: Task is repeatability, drift detection, receipt verification, safe-entrypoint display, or no-call boundary validation.
User does not require actual external agent participation.

Artifacts are display-only or evidence/recovery material under HOLD, with no authority mutation, promotion, registry mutation, schema mutation, shared DB mutation, endpoint replay, server start, API call, or API-direct work.
Known four-shape loop fields remain stable across intake, space_reading, merge, and receipt.
Positive cases pass 3/3, drift classes pass 5/5, validation checks pass 8/8, and active_call_hits remains 0.
Guard status is PASS_WITH_HOLD and the requested action is bounded to local artifact inspection.
heavy_mode_triggers: User explicitly requires actual Hermes/Codex/Gemini processing, not fixture-only or local validation.
Task asks whether process behavior itself is VectorFL-like, requiring comparison across agent roles and reinsertion-effect review.
Layer pressure, routing, HOLD boundary interpretation, or cross-layer guard status must be judged by independent actual agent readings.
A fresh task has ambiguous authority, promotion, registry, schema, shared DB, or current-position implications.
Guard status is STOP, HOLD_STOP_REVIEW, HOLD_UNTIL_APPROVED_MODEL_OUTPUT, or unresolved WATCH after local validation.
Local drift checks fail, required fields are unstable, active call literals appear in generated artifacts, or safe entrypoints are missing.
The expected value of reducing interpretation error exceeds roughly 135 external-agent seconds.

evidence_anchors: cross-layer guard matrix with STOP, WATCH, HOLD_STOP_REVIEW, HOLD_UNTIL_APPROVED_MODEL_OUTPUT, and PASS_WITH_HOLD statuses
recommendation.policy: Adopt a budget-gated two-lane policy: fast no-call/local validation as the default lane; heavy actual Hermes+Codex+Gemini only when explicit actual-agent participation, failed local evidence, or guard/authority ambiguity is present.

risks: Fast local validation can prove boundary cleanliness and repeatability but cannot prove actual Hermes/Codex/Gemini behavior.
Heavy actual processing is materially slower and exposed to external CLI latency or quota retry.
Artifacts reinserted as evidence must not be treated as authority, registry state, current-position application, or promotion.
HOLD_STOP_REVIEW must remain first-class; collapsing it into PASS_WITH_HOLD would hide routing risk.
A policy based only on elapsed time may under-escalate tasks where authority or cross-layer ambiguity is the real risk.

fast_local_validation.observed_issue: Local artifact validation is extremely fast and stable, but insufficient when the user intent requires actual Hermes/Codex/Gemini participation.

heavy_actual_multi_agent.observed_issue: Actual CLI agent calls dominate time; Gemini quota retry in first pass proves external agent latency must be budgeted.

gemini.budget_gate_shape: ACTUAL_MULTI_AGENT_SCENARIO1_FRESH_TASK_REPEAT_WITH_BUDGET_GATE_V0 (Gated multi-agent execution with deliberate time measurement and quality gain assessment).
gemini.confidence: HIGH (Verified via PASS verdicts for actual multi-agent scenario and four-shape repeatability/drift tests).
gemini.hermes_process_rule: Hermes must consume trace rows for routing, treat HOLD_STOP_REVIEW as first-class, and merge actual Codex/Gemini CLI artifacts before execution.
gemini.layer_pressure_reading: Actual multi-agent processing (135.02s) provides deep surface/logic/data/program/guard layer reading that no-call local loops (0.001s) cannot replicate. Pressure is identified in the tension between 'process-as-VectorFL' quality and real external agent latency/quota risks.
gemini.risks: External agent quota retry latency, spatial drift in evidence reinsertion, and over-promotion of local fixture results in place of actual agent validation.
gemini.role: Layer Pressure Evaluator / Quality Gate Analyst
gemini.when_fast_is_safer: Optimal for repeatability/drift tests and display-only recovery surfaces where zero active call hits are a strict boundary requirement and execution speed is prioritized over depth.
gemini.when_heavy_is_worth_it: Required when the task demands actual space exploration and reinsertion-effect review to satisfy user principle: the processing loop itself must be VectorFL-like, not just a fixture-based simulation.

post_review_decision.reason: SKIP_POST_REVIEW: Codex and Gemini both returned heavy/fast trigger structures; no STOP/HOLD_STOP_REVIEW conflict detected.
